portal.ruling: Portal Phase-2 causal treatment model must be species-specific for Chaetodipus penicillatus; the planned multispecies treatment hierarchy is not estimable under the frozen N>=5 gate.

neon.ruling: Primary habitat inference must distinguish within-site contrasts from cross-site replicated contrasts; it may not use the broad habitat totals as if habitat were unconfounded with site.

cross_dataset.ruling: Portal and NEON remain complementary public-data analyses at the process level, not a same-species replication pair.

design_amendments_required: replace Portal multispecies treatment model with Chaetodipus penicillatus primary causal analysis
split NEON within-site habitat contrasts from cross-site habitat replication
explicitly position the NEON analysis against O'Fallon et al. 2025, which already tested density-by-habitat effects on Peromyscus individual home-range area
retain Packing_z as a population-level abundance-conditioned spatial-packing response rather than an individual home-range metric
remove same-species Portal-NEON replication as a required synthesis
freeze Peromyscus cryptic-complex sensitivity before model fitting
modeling_boundary: No ecological model may be implemented or fit until the amended Phase-2 design is reviewed and approved.
